notes: v540 — a fix for why everything suddenly looked weak. Two updates ago a bug fix restored hundreds of shares that had been wrongly excluded from grading — correct in principle, but it let in a crowd of shares that BARELY TRADE: they sit at exactly the same price most days, then jump a whole tick. The giveaway was every signal line showing a median of +0.00%. Those shares contribute a mass of zeros plus rare huge swings — variance without information — and they were cutting real edges roughly in half and drowning the strength score, which is why so little could reach SOLID. With the matching server update they are now measured out (as are shares that have stopped trading), on exactly the same principle as the existing $50k/day tradeability floor: only grade shares where a percentage return actually means something. The card declares how many were set aside and why. Expect edges and strength to RISE — not because the bar moved, but because the noise left the room. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
